**Repaired finding submitted — still compliant, no redline and no counterparty comment.**

What changed in the repair:

- **Quote replaced** with Section 10(a)(iv)–(v) (¶p0051), the limb that actually carries the IP coverage, rather than the indemnity's opening words. This puts the operative linkage in the evidence itself.
- **Rationale now expressly addresses the failed heuristic**: the Vendor indemnity does not *exclude* IP infringement — it covers it through two routes, (a) "arising out of or in connection with" the Services and Auction Platform, and (b) the breach-of-warranty limb incorporating the express non-infringement warranty at Section 9(b)(i). The keyword miss reflects drafting style, not a scope gap.
- **Paragraph set expanded** to include the cross-referenced warranty (p0033), the Creative limb (p0050) and the limitation-of-liability carve-out (p0027), so each element of the preferred position is traceable to a paragraph on the record.
- **Preferred-position mapping made explicit**: IP infringement (10(a)(i)–(ii), (iv) + 9(b)(i)); Vendor breach of law (9(b)(ix)); Vendor-caused data breach (9(b)(iii)); Vendor negligence/misconduct (10(a)(v)) — plus standard procedure at Section 11 and no applicable cap given the Section 7(a) carve-out, which is why the fallback 3× super-cap is not needed.
- **Minor sub-elements retained as notes**, not deviations: the wider "acts or omissions of Customer" limb at 10(b)(v) and the "best of its knowledge" qualifier at 10(a)(iii).

Classification is unchanged because the clause meets the preferred position on every material term; per the playbook's semantics, a compliant clause is not redlined.
